section.title: International skilled-worker and apprenticeship placement between Morocco and Germany
section.subtitle: We connect motivated young talent and qualified professionals from Morocco with German companies and training institutions. Our focus is on targeted placement, personal support and long-term career prospects.

items.title: Placement of apprentices
items.desc: We give motivated young people from Morocco access to vocational training (Ausbildung) positions in Germany. We take their school qualifications, language skills and career interests into account to place them in suitable training opportunities across different industries.

items.title: Placement of skilled workers
items.desc: We support qualified professionals from Morocco in finding suitable employment in Germany. By considering their professional skills, work experience and individual career goals, we lay the foundation for a successful placement.

items.title: Recruitment for companies and institutions
items.desc: We help German companies and institutions recruit motivated apprentices and qualified professionals from Morocco. Based on your individual staffing needs, we identify suitable candidates and present matching applicant profiles.

items.title: Cooperation with training and educational institutions
items.desc: We work with nursing schools, training centres and other educational institutions to promote international training opportunities, supporting collaboration between education providers, training companies and suitable applicants from Morocco.

faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.subtitle: Can't find your question? Feel free to contact us directly.

items.q: Which countries do your applicants come from?
items.a: Our focus is Morocco. We place motivated young talent and skilled professionals from Morocco with companies and training institutions across Germany.

items.q: How can I apply as a candidate?
items.a: Simply via WhatsApp or email. Send us your CV and we'll get back to you.
Yes. We arrange online interviews between applicants and employers.

items.q: Do you also support after arrival in Germany?
items.a: Yes. We help with airport pick-up, finding accommodation, registration, bank account, health insurance and dealing with authorities, among others.

items.q: Which languages do you offer your service in?
items.a: We communicate in German, English, French and Arabic.

items.q: In which fields do you place candidates?
items.a: Among others in care & health, gastronomy, hospitality, trades & technical, and industry.

items.q: Do you work with educational institutions?
items.a: Yes. We cooperate with nursing schools, training centres and other educational institutions, and support their collaboration with training companies and suitable applicants from Morocco.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.subtitle: Information on how we process your personal data under the GDPR.

privacy.disclaimer: This is a template. Please adapt it to your actual data processing and have it reviewed by a lawyer.

sections.heading: 1. Controller
body: The controller responsible for processing personal data on this website within the meaning of Art. 4(7) GDPR is:

El Harda und Taib GbR
Trading name: Chance Connect
Reumontstraße 9
52064 Aachen
Germany
Partners: Noureddine El Harda and Anouar Taib

sections.heading: 2. Collection of personal data
body: We process personal data when you contact us via the contact form, by email, phone or WhatsApp Business, or send us application documents.
This includes in particular your name, contact details, messages, CVs, diplomas and references, language certificates and information about your professional qualifications.
We use this data to process your enquiries, to communicate with you, and to prepare and provide our placement and support services.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose and legal basis
body: Processing is carried out to handle your enquiry and for placement on the basis of Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing of personal data
body: We pass on application documents and other personal data to potential training companies or employers where this is necessary for the agreed placement and an appropriate legal basis exists.
We inform applicants before passing on their data and agree on it with them. Where the sharing is based on consent, this consent can be withdrawn at any time with effect for the future.
Technical service providers may also process personal data to the extent necessary to provide our website and for communication.

sections.heading: 5. Retention period
body: We store your data only for as long as necessary for the stated purposes or as required by law.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
body: Subject to the statutory provisions, you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability.
You may object to processing based on legitimate interests. You can withdraw any consent you have given at any time with effect for the future.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.
To exercise your rights, you can contact us at info@chanceconnect.de.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies and tracking
body: We do not use cookies for advertising or analytics purposes and do not use any corresponding tracking tools to analyse visitor behaviour.
Where cookies or similar technologies are required for the technical operation of our website, they are used exclusively to provide the website and make it work.

sections.heading: 8. Data protection contact
body: For any privacy questions, contact us at info@chanceconnect.de.

sections.heading: 9. Hosting and access data
body: Our website and our business email mailboxes are hosted by Hostinger.

When you visit our website, technically necessary connection data is processed. This includes in particular the IP address and information about the page request. The hosting provider may record this data in server logs.
The processing serves to provide our website and keep it secure and stable. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in the secure and reliable operation of our website.

sections.heading: 10. WhatsApp Business
body: You can contact us voluntarily via WhatsApp Business. In doing so, we process your phone number, messages and any files you send in order to handle your enquiry.
Depending on the context, the legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR.
When you use WhatsApp, the provider also processes personal data. This may involve data processing outside the European Economic Area.
Alternatively, you can contact us by email.
You can find more information on data protection at WhatsApp at:
https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy-eea

hero.title: Terms and conditions
hero.subtitle: The terms governing the use of our placement services for applicants and employers.

terms.disclaimer: This is a template. Please adapt the terms to your actual services and have them reviewed by a lawyer.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
body: Services are provided by El Harda und Taib GbR, trading as Chance Connect, Reumontstraße 9, 52064 Aachen, Germany. The partnership operates as a recruitment agency (Personalvermittlung) and is represented by its partners Noureddine El Harda and Anouar Taib.
These general terms and conditions (GTC) apply to all services provided by El Harda und Taib GbR ("we" or "ChanceConnect") to applicants and employers ("users").
Any conflicting terms of the user shall only apply if we expressly agree to them in writing.

sections.heading: 2. Subject of the services
body: El Harda und Taib GbR supports applicants and companies in initiating apprenticeship and employment relationships in Germany.
Our services include in particular searching for suitable apprenticeship places and jobs and putting applicants and companies in contact with each other.
In addition, we offer organisational support, for example with compiling documents, arranging appointments, and arriving and settling in in Germany.
The type and scope of the services in each case are determined by the individual agreement.
El Harda und Taib GbR is not the employer of the persons it supports or places.
We do not provide legal advice and do not make official decisions. In particular, we cannot guarantee that a visa or any other official permit will be granted.

sections.heading: 3. Formation of the contract
body: The presentation of our services on the website does not constitute a binding offer to enter into a contract.
Contacting us via our website, by email, phone or WhatsApp does not in itself create a contract subject to payment.
A contract subject to payment is concluded when the parties have agreed on the specific service and its remuneration and the statutory formal requirements have been met.
Statutory information obligations remain unaffected.

sections.heading: 4. User obligations to cooperate
body: The user shall provide all information and documents required for placement completely and truthfully and keep them up to date.
The user is responsible for the accuracy of the data, certificates and proof of qualifications submitted.

sections.heading: 5. Fees
body: We do not charge people seeking an apprenticeship any fee for placement in an apprenticeship or for any services required to prepare and carry out this placement.

Separate, voluntary additional services that are not part of the apprenticeship placement may be charged for separately where permitted by law. Circumventing statutory prohibitions on fees is excluded.
The type, scope and price of additional services subject to a fee are agreed individually before they are commissioned. Without such an agreement, there is no obligation to pay.
Fees charged to training companies, employers and other contractual partners are agreed separately. The statutory provisions on job and apprenticeship placement remain unaffected.

sections.heading: 6. No placement guarantee
body: We provide our services with the utmost care but do not owe any particular outcome. There is no entitlement to the conclusion of a training or employment relationship or to the granting of a visa.
Decisions by employers and authorities are beyond our control.

sections.heading: 7. Liability
body: We are liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence as well as for damage arising from injury to life, body or health.
In the case of simple negligence, we are liable only for the breach of a material contractual obligation and limited to the foreseeable damage typical of the contract.

sections.heading: 8. Data protection
body: Personal data is processed in accordance with our privacy policy.

sections.heading: 9. Right of withdrawal
body: Consumers may have a statutory right of withdrawal for distance contracts or contracts concluded away from business premises.
Where a right of withdrawal exists, we provide separate information on its conditions and how to exercise it before the contract is concluded.
Statutory consumer rights remain unaffected.

sections.heading: 10. Final provisions
body: German law applies. Mandatory consumer protection provisions remain unaffected.
Should individual provisions of these general terms and conditions be invalid, the remaining provisions shall remain valid. The statutory provisions shall apply in place of invalid provisions.
